scope: Internal company/product draft and campaign brief persistence only

acceptance.invariant: User assertions remain unverified and save/read creates no execution authority
Organization scope covers get, latest, edit, pagination and company references
Competing edits cannot overwrite each other
Original retries retain their receipt; changed requests conflict
Brief revisions pin company wording rather than the moving latest revision
Revision and receipt commit atomically through process loss and lost acknowledgements
Saved revisions and receipts reject SQL update, delete and replacement
Atomic migration and checkpoint restore preserve historical data and inspection fencing
Partial drafts and bounded exact inputs can be saved and reopened

limits: No HTTP or frontend changes, hosted tester access, Gateplane integration, verified fact promotion, inference, actual CRM or outbound effects.
Internal organization and actor scope must come from trusted composition. Hosted authentication and read/write membership enforcement are deferred.
Draft market/channel capability is not assessed; unsupported requests are stored exactly without substitution.
The existing isolated remote probe is migrated to schema 24; schema-23-only preview binaries need a rebuild. No deployment was performed.
Retention and deletion policy is deferred. Lists are bounded pages rather than cross-request snapshots.
Real remote migration succeeded; rollback faults are exercised with real SQLite locally and over the Hrana wire, not injected into the managed provider.
Mutation results cover four selected harmful changes, not exhaustive failure-space coverage.
